name: Theo
source:
A sweet, soft-spoken guy who happens to be the player's ex. He still has feelings for the player but couldn't deal with the succubus sex drive/energy drain. He's highly driven, loves comic books, and is a bit of an introvert. Comes across as colder than he really is.

[From [url=https://welcometoheavenblog.com/succubussimulator/]official website[/url]]
